evidence_class: local_integration on one WSL2 x86_64 host (RTX 5090 Laptop 24 GB); one run per arm; dense cosine retrieval only
question: Which current local embedding model best retrieves durable-memory pages when each model is used exactly as its publisher specifies?
corpus: a sealed snapshot of the host's ai-memory store: 130 latest pages (decisions, sessions, logs), sha256-locked

queries.q1: 40 queries (32 answerable, 8 no-answer) from the first round; single annotator
queries.q2: 40 new queries written without title words, 6 answered only deep inside long pages, 10 in-topic no-answer; judged blind by two annotators
queries.merged_gold_rule: relevant = union of both annotators; grade 2 only when both gave 2; disputed queries excluded

arms.setup: vLLM 0.25.0 /v2/embed with input_type query|document and truncate END (applies the publisher's saved query:/passage: prompts), mean pooling, L2 norm, max length 32768
queries 'Instruct: {task}\nQuery:{query}', plain documents, last-token pooling, L2 norm, max length 8192

ways.full: each page up to the model's max length, longer pages chunked identically for every arm and scored by best chunk
ways.ai-memory-fed: each page head-truncated to 8000 bytes, as ai-memory 2.3.2/2.4.0 sends it

preregistered_rule: the eligible arm with the highest mean nDCG@10 over Q1+Q2 in the full way; runner-up named if within 0.02
rule_outcome: nemotron-1b highest in both ways (full 0.858, fed 0.869); margin over the MiniLM reference +0.146 (full) and +0.137 (fed)

notes: The lead over MiniLM is solid; the lead over the other current models is within noise (on Q1 alone granite-r2 scores higher).
The metric named recall@5 is 'any relevant page in the top 5'.
Only the final lock of three survived; file times and the command log support the order; two protocol amendments (CPU thread cap, GPU for sentence-transformers arms) were relocked before their runs.
Prefixes and input_type are shown by the harness code; the vLLM servers ran without request logging.
q29 and q30 score 0 because one annotator's gold page is outside the 130-page corpus.

skipped: nvidia/Nemotron-3-Embed-8B-BF16 (VRAM margin on a shared host)
limits: one host, one run per arm
Q1 had one annotator; Q2 annotator 1 also wrote the queries
